public_rationale: Marcus predicted that in 2025 people would keep weakening the definition of AGI or defining it in financial terms. In February 2025, Microsoft's CEO dismissed AGI milestones and said the real benchmark is 10% world economic growth. In mid-2025, Altman called AGI not a useful term. Reports also described commercial manoeuvring over the contract's AGI clause. A profit-based contractual AGI definition between Microsoft and OpenAI, first reported in December 2024, stayed in force through 2025.
limitations: 'Play games' is evaluative, so the grading treats prominent economic or loosened framings as enough.
The profit-based definition dates from before 2025; only its continuation falls within the year.
